_: Kill-check for asc-zimu (E32.3). The broken-pipe guard used to act on EPIPE alone; a reader that destroys the pipe mid-write produces ENOTCONN instead, and @oclif/core's own stdout handler -- registered earlier, EPIPE-or-rethrow -- answered first and rethrew. Both halves of that fix get a mutant: the errno set, and the registration order. Measured on the real binary 2026-10-13: 3 of 300 runs exited 1 with a Node crash dump before, 0 of 600 after.
